reason: Verified in source and by driving the page; every load-bearing claim holds, and two of them are worse than stated. render-b.js:569 appends .b-editHost inside .b-stick, which precedes the measure in .b-two, so the panel is genuinely before the rows in DOM order (compareDocumentPosition confirms editor-before-row). openEditor (render-b.js:471-479) never moves focus: after pressing Enter on row 4's .b-grab at 1440, document.activeElement is still that .b-grab and .b-edit does not contain it. The walk back is 11 Shift+Tabs, not eight (grab -> 3 earlier grabs -> Delete this moment -> Done -> Hidden -> Shown -> +7 -> +1 -> -1 -> -7), so the finding understates its own defect. The panel has role=null, no aria-label/labelledby and no heading; the .b-grab carries neither aria-expanded nor aria-controls, so nothing announces that a panel opened or which moment it edits. The occlusion claim reproduces verbatim: at 768x1024 with the editor open at scrollY 0, elementFromPoint over the 'Menu tasting at The Orchard' .b-grab centre resolves inside .b-edit. It is not a one-off - at 390x844, 768x1024 and 1024x768 the fixed sheet buries between one and three tabbable .b-grab controls at every scroll position sampled, and at maximum scroll the buried row is 'Wedding day', the anchor of the entire plan, with no scroll left to free it. That is an occluded-but-operable control the behaviour gate cannot see: interaction-check.mjs:84-89 tests only rect size, visibility, display and opacity, and its editor block (lines 555-579) asserts position:fixed and plate opacity, never occlusion, never focus placement, never the ARIA pair. Nothing here restates a gate assertion, nothing here needs a fourth colour, a third weight or an architecture change - the sheet stays a sheet, it just stops standing on live controls.
sharpenedFix: Keep the ARIA half as written (.b-edit id="b-edit" + role="group" + aria-labelledby to a new h3 naming the moment; .b-grab gets aria-controls="b-edit" and an aria-expanded that openEditor/closeEditor flip), but change the focus target and the scroll maths. Do NOT focus the -7 stepper: it puts a destructive date shift under the next Enter or Space, and on the 390 sheet focusing #b-edit-title instead would raise the soft keyboard over the panel. Give .b-edit tabindex="-1" and focus the panel itself at the end of openEditor, after place(); the labelled group announces which moment is being edited, the next Tab lands on 'What it is', and the existing closeEditor(focusBack) return path to .b-grab is untouched (interaction-check.mjs:487 keeps passing). For the reserved band, set the padding on the root while the sheet is fixed - root is the .b-field element wireOwner receives, so .b-field[data-editor-open] is the right selector - writing a CSS custom property from the measured sheet offsetHeight + 24 inside a media query capped at max-width:1279px, and re-measuring on resize so a wrapped panel does not under-reserve. scrollIntoView({block:"nearest"}) will not respect that band, because a position:fixed sheet is outside layout: give .b-item a matching scroll-margin-bottom from the same custom property, or use block:"center" below 1280. Then assert three things, not two: after opening at every viewport document.activeElement is inside .b-edit; no .b-grab centre resolves through elementFromPoint into .b-edit at scroll 0, mid and maximum scroll; and .b-grab aria-expanded reads true while open and false after Escape and after Done.
